svg.title: Mobile Manipulator Learning Map
svg.desc: A learning map from basic Linux and Python to a two-wheeled mobile robot arm that presses a button and picks up an object: the robot and its physics, a nine-stop route with a pass gate at every stop, and how the parts fit.
svg.text: From basic Linux and Python to a two-wheeled robot arm that presses a button and picks up an object.
Follow the numbers. Do not move on until you meet Pass. Build in simulation first, then on the real robot.

text.aria-label: W T_H = W T_B(x, y, θ) · B T_H(q)

svg.text: Hand in world = base in world × hand relative to base (q = joint angles).

text.aria-label: B T_O = B T_C · C T_O

svg.text: Target from base = camera from base (calibration) × target from camera (vision).
Wheel odometry drifts. So park, look again, and act from the base frame.
T = pose of one frame in another. W world · B base · C camera · H hand · O target.
Reference robot: two driven wheels and a
passive caster, so it stands still when powered off.
Wheels roll, they do not slide. Moving 5 cm left takes
a manoeuvre, so choose your parking pose carefully.
Stow the arm before driving. Low batteries resist tipping
under braking, but reaching still moves the ground point.
A 5-joint arm has no spare joint for this. Turning the
base adds one. Counting is necessary, not sufficient.
Squeeze force and surface friction must carry
the weight. Soft, grippy fingertips help most.
Before real motors, test: e-stop in reach, speed and joint limits, command watchdog. Stow the arm while driving.
Two ROS 2 nodes that talk. A
is valid if you can explain it.
GPU needed only at stop 7. LeRobot usually needs a thin bridge to ROS 2.
Report k of n, not a percentage. 8 of 10 is compatible with a true rate of 49–94% (95% Wilson interval), so use 20 or more trials to compare.
Typical rates: control 50–100 Hz · camera 30 Hz · policy 10–30 Hz · task about 1 Hz
The situation was not planned for
The model or sensing is wrong
The scene differs from the demos
Too slow, or failures are hard to explain
Self-balance on two wheels: inverted pendulum, IMU, LQR
Map the room: SLAM and Nav2
Train in simulation: RL with MuJoCo Playground or Isaac Lab (GPU)
Take instructions: foundation models such as SmolVLA
Times are planning estimates at about 8 hours per week, about 26 weeks in total, not measurements. Pass
targets are starter values: tune them to your hardware and justify the change. Learn lists the words to search for.
Reference kit, checked Nov 2026: SO-101 arm (5 joints + gripper) · 2 geared DC motors with encoders · caster · single-board computer ·
camera · Ubuntu 24.04, ROS 2 Jazzy, Gazebo Harmonic. One option, not an endorsement. Check driver support before choosing a newer ROS 2.
